item.title: {{run}}-long Synthetic AI model release notes
item.description: The release notes describe a larger context window and faster responses on common workloads. Did the team change the training data mix this time? Yes, the notes say the new mix favours code and structured text. Early testers reported that answers stayed consistent across very long inputs! The model ships in three sizes, and each size has its own pricing tier. Safety evaluations were run before launch and the summary of results is published alongside the model. Developers can try the model through the existing interface without changing their integration. Why does this matter for small teams? Lower cost per request means more experiments fit inside the same budget. The company also announced a program that gives researchers free access for a limited period. Documentation was updated with migration guidance, examples and a list of known limitations. Independent reviewers will publish their own comparison next month. Feedback from the first week will shape the next point release! Northwind Labs today released Meridian 2, a synthetic language model built for long documents.
